title: CLARKSONS HELLAS - SnP WEEKLY
summary:
CLARKSONS HELLAS - SnP WEEKLY
**Broker**: Clarksons
**Published Date**: 11/09/2026
**Source URL**: [https://www.hellenicshippingnews.com/clarksons-hellas-snp-weekly-9/](https://www.hellenicshippingnews.com/clarksons-hellas-snp-weekly-9/)

Market Report Content
Clarkson Hellas Ltd. Desk Talk
As spot rates remain on a strong trend across both Wet and Dry spaces, we ran through another week
where we observed all-time-high tanker, and very strong dry cargo tonnage prices , while appetite for
secondhand vessels is continuing to absorb the elevated price levels. On the tanker side, rising crude and product prices have pushed VLCC earnings on the traditional route
and global MR averages to $300,000/day and $37,200/day, respectively.
